name: TAROGE (Taiwan)
full_name: Taiwan Astroparticle Radiowave Observatory for Geosynchrotron Emissions
summary: A radio air-shower programme on the eastern Taiwan coastal mountains searches for ultra-high-energy cosmic rays and Earth-skimming tau-neutrino signatures. It is distinct from its Antarctic extension TAROGE-M.
detection_principle: High-elevation antennas looking toward the ocean detect direct or reflected geomagnetic radio pulses from near-horizon air showers. Interferometric reconstruction distinguishes downward cosmic-ray showers from potential upward tau-decay showers.

sites.name: Heping and Nanao coastal mountain stations, eastern Taiwan
sites.location: Heping and Nanao coastal mountain stations, eastern Taiwan

status.label: Operating / data taking

key_parameters.name: Taiwan stations
key_parameters.value: Four stations deployed during 2014–2019; historical phases differ

key_parameters.name: TAROGE-4 receiver
key_parameters.value: Four dual-polarisation log-periodic dipole antennas, 180–350 MHz

key_parameters.name: TAROGE-4 sampling
key_parameters.value: Eight channels at 1.25 Gsample/s, with 12-bit digitisation

results.summary: Reported reconstruction, calibration and cosmic-ray air-shower searches. Air-shower candidates are not a confirmed tau-neutrino sample.

science_scope: Published limits are not neutrino detections. Instrument or exposure parameters refer to the explicitly named campaign; research prototypes and future designs are distinguished.
